email.subject: Quick fix for Gearhead Works' site
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Gearhead Works Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching for an auto shop can't tap to call you directly, and there's no online booking, so anyone who wants to schedule outside business hours just leaves. Your hours also aren't listed, which adds friction for new customers checking if you're open.

I fix these kinds of issues for local businesses for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
